STRATEGIC CO-OP RPG: SURVIVE THE HORDE

Your journey begins with intense hold-the-line battles, quickly opening up to diverse theme dungeons and complex mazes. This is a true Class-Based RPG where ranged firepower, class synergy, and mana management dictate survival. Team up and bond with players worldwide in the ultimate social dungeon-crawling experience!  

THE FOUR LEGENDS

Define the battlefield with unique primary attacks and two active skills:  The Armored: Frontline DPS with heavy firepower and raw physical destruction.  The Healer: Team core. Channel holy light to sustain allies and turn the tide.  The Mechanic: Technology master. Deploy tactical gadgets and unleash stunning electrical arcs.  The Summoner: Void commander. Call forth loyal minions and manipulate dark energies.  

CYAN CRYSTAL JADE & PROGRESSION

Conquer deep labyrinths to harvest Cyan Crystal Jade, the core material needed to ascend your character. Customize your build through 7 distinct attributes: ATK, Max HP, Max MP, DEF, Movement Speed, and specialized Skill Power (Skill 1 & Skill 2). Manage your Mana (MP) wisely—every cast is a tactical decision.  

ZERO GRIND, ALL THRILLS

Fast-Start: Complete the 10-minute tutorial and jump directly to Level 5, unlocking your first core skill.  Epic Scale: Brace for massive, multi-wave assaults pushing teamwork and social coordination to the limit.  True F2P: No pay-to-win. Only high-quality, full-model Avatar skins are for sale to showcase your style in social hubs.
